video_reviews.question: What should my pre-season fitness look like?
video_reviews.notes: Focusing on lower body power and core stability for wicketkeeping endurance.

feedback.technical_mistakes: Squat depth is limited; insufficient ankle dorsiflexion mobility.
feedback.strengths: Strong cardiovascular endurance base and quick first step reaction.
feedback.areas_to_improve: Rotational power for explosive lateral movements behind stumps.
feedback.recommended_drills: Lateral bounding, medicine ball scoop throws, Bulgarian split squats.
feedback.match_advice: Hydrate with electrolyte balance 30 minutes before warmups.
feedback.additional: Log your RPE (Rate of Perceived Exertion) after each session.
feedback.overall_assessment: Solid athletic foundation. Implement the targeted mobility routine for peak preseason gains.

video_reviews.question: Struggling against short-pitched bowling.
video_reviews.notes: I tend to pull early and get top edges over mid-wicket.

video_reviews.question: My throws are losing accuracy from the boundary.
video_reviews.notes: Struggling to keep flat trajectories into the keeper's gloves.

video_reviews.question: How can I generate more swing with the new ball?
video_reviews.notes: Wrist seam angle falls slightly toward fine leg during delivery stride.

feedback.technical_mistakes: Wrist angle wobbles at point of release.
feedback.strengths: Strong run-up momentum and high release point.
feedback.areas_to_improve: Locked wrist position through follow through.

video_reviews.question: My cover drive feels mistimed. What am I doing wrong?
video_reviews.notes: Checked video at 0:15 - front knee collapses occasionally.

feedback.technical_mistakes: Head falling across off-stump; weight on back foot.
feedback.recommended_drills: Shadow batting with headcam, tee work focusing on front elbow.
feedback.match_advice: Play straight for first 10 balls — don't force the cover drive early.
feedback.overall_assessment: Strong fundamentals with specific technical fixes to work on.
